item.title: My Giant Friend
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hentai Room
  • 発売日: 2022-11-10
  • スコア: 5.09/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: My Giant Friend
  • 英語名: My Giant Friend

あらすじ

After being disrespected several times in her village, Runi, a young florist, decided to find a giant woman who was desperate to repair her vegetable garden.

Runi’s goal was fairly simple: help the giant in exchange for learning how to make everyone respect her. And that started to happen after she met Lady Blerog, a fierce retired warrior who had a secret vitamin whey capable of turning any human into a giant.
